title.narrative: Closing gaps in the national response to tuberculosis with emphasis on multidrug resistance, vulnerable population (pediatric - PPL) and community health systems - Peru (01-Jul-2019-30-Jun-2022)

description.narrative: Peru, Tuberculosis, Socios en Salud sucursal Peru (SOCIOS EN SALUD)This program has the following goals: To reduce progressively the incidence and morbidity and mortality due to tuberculosis with emphasis on multiresistance and to improve the control of the disease in a highly vulnerable population (Pediatric - PPL). The objectives of this program are: Strengthen the capacity of health services to provide a comprehensive and innovative response for the detection of cases and the treatment of people affected with TB with emphasis on resistant TB. Strengthen the capacity of health services in prioritized areas for prevention and control activities in key populations. Strengthen interventions for community responses and systems. Strengthen interventions for health information systems, monitoring and evaluation
